patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Bombora and Gong share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Bombora only if your buying job matches “Intent-data specialist (Company Surge®) for B2B account prioritization — not a contact dat” rather than Gong's shape. Choose Gong only if your buying job matches “Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custom proposal” rather than Bombora's shape. Workflow advantage: Bombora leans prospecting, data-enrichment; Gong leans sales-engagement. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Bombora and Gong share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Bombora is Intent-data specialist (Company Surge®) for B2B account prioritization — not a contact database; custom-quote packaging.; Gong is Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custom proposal only (no public dollar list)..
- Workflow coverage skew: Bombora-leaning prospecting, data-enrichment vs Gong-leaning sales-engagement.
- Researched limits: Bombora — Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database; Gong — Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases.

Limitations — Bombora: Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database; Custom-quote only via speak-to-an-expert path; Gong: Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases; Not a prospecting/enrichment data core.

Poor-fit cases: Bombora is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database · Gong is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases · Avoid Bombora if you actually need Gong's motion (Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custo)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
